claims.statement: DE to DEBBI is Juri's selected creative continuation.
DEBBI is a Juri-defined program-code and memory-anchor concept. Displayed DEBBI lines are editorial project output and are not attributed to a real person.

The displayed EVM address was supplied twice by Juri and passes the EIP-55 mixed-case checksum.
The approximately 31-year span is Juri's approximate self-reported memory horizon, not verified complete coverage or a clinical memory reconstruction.
The Alzheimer wording is a humorous expression of motivation for personal archiving and establishes no diagnosis, prognosis, prevention, treatment or efficacy.
The face-washing line is an invented scene image, not an observed external event or identification of a person.
